_comment: COPY-PASTE SNIPPET for market/catalog/models.json. Map your app id to the SHARED model files that must be dropped into a device dir (target_path) at install time. Only for apps whose package does NOT bundle the model. Stage the real bytes under market/packaging/models/<app_id>/<filename>; gen_catalog.py hashes them and emits catalog models[]. Everything here is hand-written EXCEPT the hashes (gen_catalog computes those). target_path MUST resolve inside /userdata/local/models (modelstore whitelist).
